cases.scope: Design refinement for checked scan-lock initialization, already-owned log rollback, owned destruction on two cleanup entries, and two slot generations. One remote user; admission closes before destruction and all admitted users leave under fairness. Ticket/POSIX/void and single-thread configurations retained. Legacy controls expose ignored init, owned leak, double destruction and admission after closing. Initialized global/VM memory and returning primitive contracts assumed. Source caller barriers are locators, not a proven C-level quiescence edge. Excludes actual OS, signal/C weak-memory behavior, arbitrary GC graphs, full native lifecycle/bootstrap/Gerbil admission.
